statement:
∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → 
 (Summable (fun j => ‖f j‖*‖g j‖) ∧ (∑' j, ‖f j‖*‖g j‖) ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g) ∧
 ∀ k, Summable (fun j => f j*g (k-j)) ∧ ‖KdVPlan.mul f g k‖ ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g
proof:
intro f g hf hg
have cs : ∀ a b : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 a → KdVPlan.MemH 0 b → Summable (fun j => ‖a j‖*‖b j‖) ∧ (∑' j, ‖a j‖*‖b j‖) ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 a*KdVPlan.hn 0 b := by
 intro a b ha hb
 let x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := ⟨a, (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T013 a).1.mp ha⟩
 let y : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := ⟨b, (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T013 b).1.mp hb⟩
 have hc : (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal.HolderConjugate (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal := by rw [Real.holderConjugate_iff]; norm_num
 have KdVPlan.hn₁ : KdVPlan.hn 0 a = ‖x‖ := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T013 a).2 _
 have KdVPlan.hn₂ : KdVPlan.hn 0 b = ‖y‖ := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T013 b).2 _
 simpa only [KdVPlan.hn₁, KdVPlan.hn₂] using lp.tsum_mul_le_mul_norm hc x y
refine ⟨cs f g hf hg, ?_⟩
intro k
have hgk := yui_aux_0004 T gamma R h_T013 g k hg
have H := cs f (fun j => g (k-j)) hf hgk.1
constructor
· exact Summable.of_norm (by simpa only [norm_mul] using H.1)
· exact (tsum_of_norm_bounded H.1.hasSum (fun j => (norm_mul _ _).le)).trans (by simpa [hgk.2] using H.2)
